changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Route warehouse inventory questions to executable Trino mysql catalog templates instead of unpublished fixed-report placeholders.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO copilot_ai.nl2sql_query_template (template_code, domain, role_hint, intent_patterns, question_samples, sql_template, parameters, target_view, description, priority, is_active) VALUES ('TPL-53', 'warehouse', NULL, '[".*(库存现量|当前库存|库存现状|库存总览|库存看板).*", ".*(展示|查看|查询|统计).*(库存).*"]', '["展示当前库存现状","库存现量按库房和SKU汇总"]', $tpl$SELECT COALESCE(storehouse_name, '未填') AS "库房", CAST(good_price_id AS VARCHAR) AS "SKU", COALESCE(good_name, '未填') AS "物品名称", COALESCE(good_norms, '') AS "规格", COALESCE(good_specs, '') AS "属性", COALESCE(good_unit, '') AS "单位", SUM(COALESCE(good_number, 0)) AS "可用库存", ROUND(SUM(CAST(COALESCE(good_number, 0) AS DOUBLE) * CAST(COALESCE(out_cost, 0) AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS "库存成本", COUNT(*) AS "库存行数", MAX(update_time) AS "最近更新时间" FROM mysql.rs_cloud_flower.s_stock_info WHERE (del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag = '0') GROUP BY COALESCE(storehouse_name, '未填'), good_price_id, COALESCE(good_name, '未填'), COALESCE(good_norms, ''), COALESCE(good_specs, ''), COALESCE(good_unit, '') ORDER BY 7 DESC, 8 DESC LIMIT 100$tpl$, '{}', 'mysql.rs_cloud_flower.s_stock_info', '库存现量按库房和 SKU 汇总（Trino 联邦 MySQL）', 46, true), ('TPL-54', 'warehouse', NULL, '[".*(低库存|缺货).*(预警|告警|清单|列表|情况).*", ".*(库存).*(不足|偏低|低于|小于).*(预警|告警|清单|列表|情况)?.*"]', '["查看低库存SKU清单","低库存预警"]', $tpl$SELECT COALESCE(storehouse_name, '未填') AS "库房", CAST(good_price_id AS VARCHAR) AS "SKU", COALESCE(good_name, '未填') AS "物品名称", COALESCE(good_norms, '') AS "规格", COALESCE(good_specs, '') AS "属性", COALESCE(good_unit, '') AS "单位", SUM(COALESCE(good_number, 0)) AS "可用库存", ROUND(SUM(CAST(COALESCE(good_number, 0) AS DOUBLE) * CAST(COALESCE(out_cost, 0) AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS "库存成本", MAX(update_time) AS "最近更新时间" FROM mysql.rs_cloud_flower.s_stock_info WHERE (del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag = '0') GROUP BY COALESCE(storehouse_name, '未填'), good_price_id, COALESCE(good_name, '未填'), COALESCE(good_norms, ''), COALESCE(good_specs, ''), COALESCE(good_unit, '') HAVING SUM(COALESCE(good_number, 0)) <= 2 ORDER BY 7 ASC, 3 LIMIT 100$tpl$, '{}', 'mysql.rs_cloud_flower.s_stock_info', '低库存 SKU 清单（Trino 联邦 MySQL 弱路径）', 47, true) ON CONFLICT (template_code) DO UPDATE SET domain = EXCLUDED.domain, role_hint = EXCLUDED.role_hint, intent_patterns = EXCLUDED.intent_patterns, question_samples = EXCLUDED.question_samples, sql_template = EXCLUDED.sql_template, parameters = EXCLUDED.parameters, target_view = EXCLUDED.target_view, description = EXCLUDED.description, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active, updated_at = now();
